body:
under 30 seconds. that's all the getaway car bridge needed 🚗

taylor and jack antonoff were in the studio, and for whatever reason her iPhone was recording. so the song's big turn didn't just happen, it got caught on camera as it happened.

jack has spent, in his words, a "million hours" in studios. he still calls this "the only time in my life...that a camera was ever on when magic actually happened."

his theory on why that clip took off? "because it was real." i think about that so much.

the whole story is on longlivets.com → https://longlivets.com/?item=vault-reputation-the-getaway-car-bridge-written-in-under-30-seconds-on-camera&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=heartbeat
